rules.name: NoHardcodedSecrets
rules.description: Hardcoded API keys, passwords, connection strings or bearer tokens must never be committed.

rules.name: AvoidSyncOverAsync
rules.description: Never use .Result, .Wait(), or Task.WaitAll() on asynchronous operations as it leads to thread pool starvation and deadlocks.

rules.name: DependencyDirection
rules.description: Domain layer must have zero dependencies on Infrastructure or UI layers.

rules.name: NoSilentExceptionSwallowing
rules.description: Catch blocks must never be empty or swallow exceptions without logging or re-throwing.

rules.name: SingleResponsibilityViolation
rules.description: Classes exceeding high coupling or multiple divergent responsibilities must be refactored.

rules.name: AvoidExcessiveAllocations
rules.description: Avoid creating unnecessary collections or string concatenations in repetitive loops; prefer StringBuilder or Span<T>.
